title: Project Delivery Checklist
note: Fill in Status, Owner, Target Date and Remarks; Status and Responsible are dropdowns. A task is marked Completed only when its evidence is in the repository, and a status a person set is never changed.

tasks.task: Receive resource count / capacity allocation from Management
Decide and finalise the project team (Dev, QA, Architect, Lead)
Confirm PRD, User Stories, Personas, Business Objectives are ready
Confirm Functional & Non-Functional Requirements are documented
Confirm Data Models / Data Points and Acceptance Criteria are defined
Confirm UI/UX references are shared (if applicable)
Schedule and set up the Project Kickoff / Handover meeting
Conduct handover walkthrough: business requirements, user journeys, functional scope
Walk through technical constraints, timelines, milestones, deliverables, dependencies
Raise all open questions from Dev and QA during handover
Ensure all requirements are thoroughly clarified with the team; close every clarification
Obtain formal approval / sign-off on PRD and User Stories
Confirm development can begin (handover done, questions closed, PRD approved)
Create the shared project Drive folder with the standard structure
Create sub-folders: Product, Technical, Architecture, API Documentation, UI/UX, QA
Create sub-folders: Analytics, Security, Deployment, Release Notes, Client Deliverables, Meeting Notes
Apply document naming convention and version history to all documents
Create the dedicated git group for the client (PascalCase)
Create Client subgroup repositories (Web / Android / iOS)
Create Server subgroup repositories (API, Auth, Notification, Scheduler, Worker)
Verify all group / subgroup / repo names follow PascalCase and are descriptive
Create dedicated cloud projects: Dev, QA, Prod (PascalCase naming)
Confirm cloud project naming with Engineering Manager if any uncertainty
Provision all cloud resources within the correct cloud project
Create the project entry in the tracker
Set up the tracker hierarchy: Project > PRD > User Stories > Tasks / Bugs > Releases
Create User Stories with clear, testable Acceptance Criteria
Add all User Stories to the tracker and link them to the PRD
Break each User Story into Development Tasks, QA Tasks and Bugs
Create all tasks within one working day of handover completion
Add Description, Acceptance Criteria, Priority, Estimated Effort, Dependencies to each task
Verify every task is linked to a User Story
Conduct the Sprint Planning meeting and distribute tasks
Assign work considering skillset, workload, sprint capacity and timelines
Confirm each Developer and QA Engineer understands their assigned scope
Prepare the UI/UX screen designs
was: Prepare UI/UX designs using Claude Design

tasks.task: Review and obtain Product team approval on UI/UX designs
Route any post-approval design change through the change management process
Prepare the High-Level Design (HLD)
HLD: System Architecture and Service Boundaries
HLD: Database Design
HLD: External Integrations
HLD: Security Considerations
HLD: Deployment Architecture
HLD: Scalability Strategy
HLD: Observability Architecture
HLD: Analytics Architecture
Prepare Low-Level Design (where applicable)
Prepare Architecture Diagram
Confirm the standard technology stack; get Architect + EM review for any deviation
Obtain architecture approval before development begins
Set up Development environment
Set up QA environment
Set up Production environment
Configure separate environment variables, databases, storage and secrets per environment
Document Environment Configuration in the project folder
Define the Backup Policy: scope, frequency, retention period and storage location
Define and document RPO (Recovery Point Objective) and RTO (Recovery Time Objective)
Configure automated database backups for QA and Production (PostgreSQL / MongoDB / ClickHouse)
Configure backups for object storage, file storage and configuration/secrets
Enable encryption at rest and restrict access to all backup buckets
Store backups in a separate location/region from the primary environment
Configure backup failure alerting and monitoring
Perform a restore drill and verify data integrity of the restored copy
Document the Backup & Restore Procedure in the Deployment folder
Verify masking rules before any Production backup is restored to a lower environment
Take a verified pre-deployment backup before each Production release
Set up the Build pipeline
Set up the Automated Testing pipeline
Set up the Deployment pipeline (fully automated and repeatable)
Define and document the Rollback strategy
Set up branching per GitFlow: main, develop, feature, bugfix, hotfix, release
Enforce branch protection: no direct commits to main or develop
Develop features per the approved design and coding standards
Follow frontend standards: React functional components, hooks, one component per file
Manage all server state via TanStack Query; Zustand only for shared state
Validate every API request and response using Zod
Use shadcn/ui as the standard component library; no new UI libraries without approval
Enforce ESLint, Prettier and TypeScript strict mode
Follow Go standards: gofmt, golangci-lint, structured logging, context propagation
Apply error wrapping, dependency injection and API versioning
Write Unit Tests for backend services
Follow database standards (PostgreSQL / MongoDB / ClickHouse) per guidelines
Raise Merge Requests for every change; delete branches after merge
Complete one Peer Review per Merge Request
Complete one Lead Review per Merge Request
Verify code quality, readability, performance, security, test coverage, architecture compliance
Create and maintain API Documentation
Update task status before Daily Scrum and move tasks to the correct Kanban status
Post End-of-Day update: work completed, progress, blockers, next-day plan
Implement structured logging (ELK / Loki)
Implement correlation IDs and request tracing
Expose metrics and health endpoints; configure Prometheus
Build Grafana dashboards (application, infrastructure, database)
Configure API latency, error and resource utilisation monitoring
Configure alerting for critical failures
Prepare the Event Design Sheet before implementation
Define event name, description, trigger, screen, attributes and business outcome
Prepare the Analytics Tracking Plan and Event Dictionary
Prepare User Journey Mapping
Implement analytics (the platform the analytics ADR names)
Implement user, session and platform attributes on every event
Ensure unique user identification across sessions and devices
Verify analytics dashboards: funnel, adoption, retention, conversion, drop-off
Involve QA from requirement analysis onwards
Write Test Cases and map them to Acceptance Criteria
Execute Functional Testing
Execute API Testing
Execute UI Testing
Execute Security Testing
Execute Performance Testing (where applicable)
Execute Cross Browser and Cross Device Testing (where applicable)
Build the UI Automation suite
Build the API Automation suite
Build the Regression Automation suite
Integrate automation into the CI/CD pipeline
Log every bug in the tracker, linked to its User Story
Include severity, priority, steps to reproduce, expected/actual result, screenshots
Retest fixes and close bugs
Support UAT in the QA environment (if applicable)
Provide QA sign-off before Production deployment
Run Dependency Scan
Run Secret Scan
Run Static Code Analysis
Conduct the code-level Security Review
was: Conduct Security Review with Claude Code (vapt-report)

tasks.task: Conduct Vulnerability Assessment and generate the VAPT Report
Fix all Critical and High vulnerabilities
Resolve Medium vulnerabilities wherever feasible before production
File the Security Review Document and VAPT Scan Report in the project folder
Assign the release Version Number
Prepare Release Notes
Prepare the Deployment Checklist and Deployment Guide
Prepare the Rollback Plan
Prepare the User Guide and Known Issues & Limitations document
Confirm QA sign-off is obtained
Deploy to Production through the approved pipeline only
Execute Smoke Testing post-deployment
Complete Production Verification
Confirm the full release checklist is complete before closing the release
PRD, User Stories and Acceptance Criteria filed and current
HLD, LLD, Architecture Diagram and Database Design filed and current
API Documentation and Environment Configuration filed and current
Test Cases and Automation Test Suite filed and current
Event Design Sheet, Tracking Plan, User Journey Mapping, Event Dictionary filed
Security Review Document and VAPT Report filed
Deployment Guide, Release Notes, User Guide, Known Issues filed
Backup Policy and Backup & Restore Procedure filed and current
Document all major technical decisions
Document and get approval for every requirement change
Communicate risks and blockers immediately
Route all client communication through the Product Owner / Project Manager
Capture and circulate meeting notes
Complete assigned learning paths and share knowledge with the team
Conduct project retrospective and capture process improvements
